Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Cerulean's clinical triage workflow — really helpful context. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan: 

- Primary goal you outlined: reduce triage latency for nurse triage and improve intent classification accuracy for intake messages.
- Success criteria you mentioned: ~30% reduction in average triage response time; model precision >= 88% on your current intent taxonomy.
- Eval scope (proposed): 2-week sandbox trial using de-identified historical transcripts (~25k messages). Redwood provides a sandbox model endpoint, initial prompt templates, and a simple scoring harness.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive + evaluation kickoff where our Solutions Engineer can walk the team through the sandbox, prompt/labeling expectations, and the mutual action plan. Proposed windows (Pacific Time):

1) Thu Apr 29 — 11:00–12:00 PT (14:00–15:00 ET)
2) Fri Apr 30 — 09:00–10:00 PT (12:00–13:00 ET)
3) Mon May 3 — 13:00–14:00 PT (16:00–17:00 ET)

If you can confirm which slot works (or share alternatives), I’ll send a calendar invite and attach a short mutual action plan draft plus the prompt-set template for review.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx (attachment stub)

Best,
Ben

Alex — perfect, thanks for confirming.

I’ve scheduled the 60-minute technical deep-dive + eval kickoff for Thu, Apr 29, 11:00–12:00 PT (calendar invite attached). Invite includes Marissa and Nadia.

Pre-read & attachments I’m sharing now (stubs attached):
- mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx — proposed milestones, owners, and timeline
- eval-prompt-set-template.md — sample prompts and label definitions we’ll use for the first pass
- Redwood-calendar-invite.ics — calendar invite stub

Quick answers to your questions:
- Data ingestion: S3 transfer is supported and the simplest route. We’ll provide temporary pre-signed URLs; all transfers must use HTTPS and we support server-side encryption (SSE). If your security team requires a private link, we can discuss a signed VPN tunnel during the session.
- De-identification: We’ll send our recommended de-id checklist prior to the call. For the first pass we can accept Cerulean-deid data, but we’ll validate de-id during onboarding.

Next steps:
1) You confirm the attendee list (names + emails) so we can grant sandbox access ahead of the call.
2) Cerulean shares a 1–2k message sample (de-id) to validate prompt behavior before the full 25k transfer.
3) We’ll run a baseline pass and return a small report within 48 hours of receiving the sample.

If anything changes on timing, let me know and I’ll adjust. Otherwise I’ll share the Drive link with the documents and a brief agenda for Apr 29.

Thanks — speak soon,
Ben
